stage1.impression: A clean high-key white seamless with a red tinted-acrylic horn speaker. The horn glows well against the white, but the cabinet reads as a murky salmon box rather than glass lit from behind. No red light reaches the floor, and a grey wedge on the left edge and a faint mint cast on the white make it read as a competent CG product render, not a launch photograph.

blocking_9: The seamless reads as neutral, even white across the frame: no grey wedge at the left edge, and no green cast (delta-E2000 to #F3F1EE at most 1.5).
The acrylic throws its own red light onto the seamless in front of and beside the base, so the object sits in its colour.
The cabinet's front face carries a graduated specular reflection (a scrim or panel read in the glass), so it reads as polished cast acrylic and not as a matte tinted box.
The cabinet front is lifted out of the mud (median luminance at least 105) while the vertical black edge lines stay crisp.
The product is larger in the frame (about 70% of the frame height) and still leaves room for type.

defects.what: A diagonal grey wedge on the seamless at the left edge (median 212 against 247 elsewhere). It reads as a flag shadow or the edge of the lit area, an uncontrolled gradient.
The white has a mint/green cast: RGB 243,248,243, delta-E2000 3.9 to the seamless's #F3F1EE (warm).
The floor in front is also green-cyan (234,240,238), delta-E 3.8.
No coloured transmitted light or red bounce on the seamless beside or in front of the cabinet: the floor is neutral 238,242,238. The tinted glass casts only a grey shadow.
The cabinet's front top band is dull and dark (median 88) with no specular reflection, so it reads as matte tinted plastic.
The internal parts behind the front (ports, box, panels) read as murky opaque salmon. They block the bright-field glow and clutter the base.
The woofer ring and cone are close to black (ring median 46, 3.75% crushed). The cone reads as a hole, with no rim highlight.
The horn's throat shows a black, blobby driver mass. The horn is the strongest part of the frame, but this mass is its darkest point.

changes.problem: The white seamless renders mint-green instead of the specified warm off-white, so the whole frame looks cold and CG.

evidence.measured: RGB 243,248,243; delta-E2000 3.89 to #F3F1EE; the floor in front is 234,240,238, delta-E 3.8

changes.expected: Background RGB about 245,243,240, with R >= G >= B, matching #F3F1EE.

changes.problem: A grey diagonal wedge darkens the left edge of the seamless, an uncontrolled gradient that will look different behind each colour.

evidence.measured: lum_median 212.4, p5 195 against 246.6 on the right side (range 0.3)

changes.problem: The tinted acrylic throws no coloured light onto the seamless, so the 'stained glass' idea of the card does not land and the object does not sit in its own light.

changes.expected: A red-tinted transmitted pool on the seamless, falling forward and right of the base: R clearly above G and B there, the floor's G dropping to about 200.

changes.problem: The front face of the cabinet has no specular reflection and sits dark, so it reads as matte tinted plastic, not polished cast acrylic.

change.setting: add lights.front-strip (panel, graduated, camera false) and adjust key
change.from: key az 5, el 20, specular 0.3; no panel

changes.expected: A soft vertical gradient reflection across the front face, its top band lifted to about 110-130, and a distinct value step between front and side.

changes.problem: The woofer cone and its red ring collapse to near black, so the cone reads as a hole in the middle of the hero.

evidence.measured: ring lum_median 46, crush 3.75%; the cone is nearly black

change.to: 2.0 x 1.0 m at [0.4, -2.2, 0.6], normal facing the woofer (about [-0.15, 0.95, 0.1]), so the camera catches a rim reflection on the surround and ring

changes.expected: A thin bright rim on the surround and a readable cone; ring median about 60-80 with no crushed pixels.

changes.problem: The speaker takes about 63% of the frame height and only 19% of its width, so at a glance it reads as small in a large empty field.

changes.problem: The contact shadow is a thin dark line with almost no soft falloff, so the 40 kg acrylic box feels light, as if set down.

out_of_scope.request: Make the internal parts (the port boxes, the internal panels, the bracing) less opaque or lighter so the cabinet glows through as the horn does.
out_of_scope.why: These are parts of the speaker. Their opacity is what most keeps the cabinet from reading as stained glass.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the black mass of the compression driver seen through the horn.
out_of_scope.why: It is the speaker's driver. It cannot be changed for a picture.
